name: Muhamed Anees K Mousafi
hook: From technical talks to leading the whole club
challenge: He was comfortable in technical and business discussions, yet not always sure his words were landing the way he intended.
transformation: Today he serves as President of Talk-Masters and leads the club with confidence, speaking to audiences with clarity and purpose.

journey.text: Joined Talk-Masters in 2024, looking for a space to step out of his comfort zone and find his voice.
Served as Sergeant at Arms in 2025–26: his first taste of club leadership.
Entrusted with the role of Club President for 2026–27.
Part of the team that helped Talk-Masters win the Smedley Award in two consecutive years and achieve 6 Distinguished Club Program goals.

impact.career: Toastmasters is helping me present my ideas clearly and engage confidently with clients, partners, and senior stakeholders.
impact.confidence: I have moved from hesitating to speak in public to leading meetings and addressing audiences with confidence.
impact.leadership: I strongly believe in out-of-the-box thinking, strategic planning, and disciplined implementation. Serving as Sergeant at Arms and now as Club President has given me the opportunity to put these beliefs into practice. Contributing to the club’s Smedley Award wins and DCP success showed me what a committed team can achieve when ideas are backed by a clear plan and consistent action.

advice: You already have the knowledge. Toastmasters helps you find the confidence to share it.
story: Anees joined Talk-Masters in 2024 to step out of his comfort zone. What began as a way to build confidence grew into a passion for leading others, and today, as Club President, he enjoys guiding and supporting fellow members on their own journeys.
contribution: Out-of-the-box thinking, strategic planning and disciplined follow-through: ideas backed by a clear plan and consistent action.

name: Hadi Abdulkader
headline: Mechanical engineer, now a public speaking trainer
challenge: As a mechanical engineer, he was confident in his technical knowledge but struggled to communicate his ideas with the same confidence. Knowing something and communicating it well, he realised, were two very different skills.
transformation: Today communication is his profession: a public speaking and workplace communication trainer who helps professionals build the skills he once struggled to build himself.

journey.text: Joined Toastmasters in 2016 with a simple goal: to become a better speaker.
Kept showing up through hesitant moments, disappointing performances and hard feedback, and found that confidence comes through practice, not before it.
Won at Division level in the Humorous Speech, International Speech and Table Topics contests.
Moved from mechanical engineering into public speaking and workplace communication training, now as Director – Trainings at Public Speaking Gym.
Invited as the Featured Speaker for Talk-Masters' 100th meeting, "Century of Voice".

impact.career: My Toastmasters journey helped me discover my passion for training and gradually transition from mechanical engineering into public speaking and workplace communication training.
impact.confidence: From hesitating to express my ideas, I have grown into someone who can address audiences, facilitate workshops, and share lessons through videos in English and Malayalam.
impact.leadership: Taking on club responsibilities, supporting fellow members, and facilitating learning experiences have helped me develop the ability to guide, encourage, and bring out the best in others.

advice: Don't wait to become confident before you start speaking. Start speaking, and confidence will follow. Just like a gym, every small practice makes you stronger.
story: “I joined Toastmasters to find my voice. Along the way, I discovered my purpose: helping others find theirs.” For Hadi, the club is still his practice ground: every speech he gives and every evaluation he receives is a reminder that there is always room to improve.
contribution: A trainer's eye for turning ideas into messages that connect: structuring a speech, strengthening an opening, using a purposeful pause, making a message memorable. And still a learner, taking something new from every meeting.

name: Prathiba Leo
headline: TEDx speaker and communication coach at TiE Dubai
hook: A TEDx speaker who decided to join within two minutes
challenge: Already a TEDx speaker and an active public speaker, Prathiba was looking for a place to keep sharpening the craft, try different formats and learn among people who enjoy communication.
transformation: Today Talk-Masters is where Prathiba practises what a communication coach preaches: speaking, evaluating, moderating and hosting, within a network that keeps growing.

journey.text: Began a Toastmasters journey in India in 2020, then took a pause after moving to Dubai.
Spoke at TEDxChennaiInstituteOfTechnology, invited under the theme of empowered women.
Came to Talk-Masters in 2025 as a guest speaker for CareerNova, delivering a masterclass on “Selling Yourself”, and decided to join within two minutes.
Served as Club Treasurer, and took up roles such as Evaluator and Toastmaster of the Day.
Moderated the panel discussion at She Leads – Where Every Woman Is a Leader, in September 2025: a conversation people still talk about.
Moderated the “Real Transformers” panel at Talk-Masters' 100th meeting.
Conducts masterclasses, visits other clubs across Dubai, and is working towards completing a first path, Visionary Communication.

impact.career: Toastmasters gives me a consistent space to practise the skills at the centre of my professional life: public speaking, moderation, facilitation, storytelling and leadership communication. It has also strengthened my visibility and credibility as a communication coach and public speaker.
impact.confidence: For me, confidence was never simply about being able to stand on a stage. Toastmasters has helped me become a more versatile and intentional communicator. Whether I am delivering a prepared speech, evaluating someone, moderating a panel, taking up an impromptu role or addressing a completely new audience, every experience stretches a slightly different communication muscle.
impact.leadership: Serving as Treasurer and taking up different club responsibilities has let me experience leadership beyond my professional role. It has taught me to contribute to a community, support other speakers, give constructive feedback, coordinate with people and, sometimes, simply step up when something needs to be done.
impact.networking: I have found an incredible network of people from completely different professions, industries and walks of life. It keeps widening every time I attend a meeting, visit another club or take part in an event, and it has exposed me to perspectives and conversations I might otherwise never have encountered.

advice: Just come in and immerse yourself in the experience. You don't need to know exactly what Toastmasters is, or wonder whether you are “good enough” to be there. Observe, participate, speak to people and experience the room. Sometimes, as it did for me, it might take just two minutes to realise you have found your people.
story: Prathiba first walked into Talk-Masters in 2025 as a guest speaker, delivering a masterclass on “Selling Yourself” at CareerNova. It took two minutes to decide to join. “There was something almost enigmatic about the vibe of Talk-Masters: the energy, the warmth and, most importantly, the people.” Since then, the club has become family, and a reminder that no matter how much you speak professionally, there is always something new to learn, practise and improve.
contribution: A TEDx speaker's craft and a professional moderator's gift for drawing people out, shared through masterclasses, panels and meeting roles.

name: Tarannum Sheikh
headline: Educator and founder of Active Kids, TEDx speaker
challenge: An educator for nearly a decade across India and the UAE, she wanted children to build the confidence that years on stage had given her.
transformation: Today she runs Active Kids, an online academy where she and her team teach children public speaking and life skills, and she speaks on the TEDx stage herself.

journey.text: Started as a Toastmaster at another club, and has spent more than nine years in Toastmasters, with over 100 speeches.
Founded Active Kids in May 2020, a virtual academy for children's skill development.
Created Speak & Shine, live public speaking and debate classes for children aged 5 to 14.
Joined Talk-Masters recently, bringing years of experience to a new room.

impact.career: Turned public speaking into an academy that has taught hundreds of children.
impact.leadership: Leads the Active Kids team of trainers.
impact.confidence: Shares her story on the TEDx stage and in her writing as an author.

advice: Start small: one minute on your feet is a beginning.
story: After more than nine years in Toastmasters, Tarannum still treats every meeting as practice. She brings that habit to Talk-Masters, and the same message to the children she teaches: start small, and keep showing up.
contribution: Nearly a decade of Toastmasters experience and more than 100 speeches, shared generously with newer members.

name: Suhayb Shaik
headline: Head of the Cyber Team, University of Wollongong in Dubai
challenge: He started out more at home with code and networks than with a microphone and a room full of faces.
transformation: Today he leads the cyber team at UOWD and the club's public relations, and designed and built this website.

journey.text: Came to Talk-Masters to practise speaking to people, not just screens.
Took on Vice President Public Relations for 2026–27, telling the club's story to Dubai.
Designed and built the club's website, so anyone can see what a meeting is like before they visit.

impact.career: Leads a university cyber team, where explaining a risk clearly matters as much as fixing it.
impact.leadership: Runs the club's public relations as part of the Executive Committee.
impact.confidence: Speaks up in rooms where he once would have stayed quiet.

advice: You don't need to feel ready. Come and watch once, and let the room do the rest.
story: Suhayb joined to practise speaking to people, not just screens, and stayed for the community. As Vice President Public Relations, he now helps tell the club's story to Dubai.
contribution: A technologist's knack for explaining things clearly, and the club's public face online.

name: Jasim Eranhole
occupation: Regional Digital Optimization Specialist, UI/UX Specialist and Graphic Leader
headline: Regional digital optimisation specialist at IKEA
challenge: He started out as a freelance artist and art teacher in India, painting commissions in acrylic and oil, before moving to Kuwait as a graphic designer in 2008.
transformation: Today he leads digital optimisation, UI/UX and graphics for IKEA across the region, from Dubai.

journey.text: Spent more than 15 years in design and digital for retail brands: FedEx Office, Debenhams and IKEA in Kuwait, then Alghanim Industries' Xcite.com, before joining IKEA in Dubai in 2022.
Joined Talk-Masters in June 2024.

story: Jasim has spent his career making ideas clear to other people: first in paint, then in print, shop windows and websites for some of the region's best-known retailers. Since June 2024, he has been practising the spoken side of that craft at Talk-Masters.

name: Nabeel Bava
hook: From nervous around senior leaders to speaking up in any room
challenge: He lacked confidence when speaking to people in positions of power or authority, such as managers and senior officials.
transformation: Today he speaks to audiences, addresses groups of colleagues, and expresses his thoughts with much greater confidence and without fear.

journey.text: First joined Talk-Masters in 2021.
Returned to Toastmasters in 2026, after a pause, to keep working on himself.
Became the club's Treasurer for 2026–27, taking on responsibilities beyond public speaking.
Served as Toastmaster of the Day for Meeting #105, after taking on roles such as Timer and Grammarian.
Developing his speaking through speeches, including "Every Car Tells a Story".

impact.career: Toastmasters is helping me communicate more effectively, express ideas clearly, and engage confidently with people at all levels of the organisation.
impact.confidence: I have moved from feeling intimidated when speaking to senior people to expressing my thoughts more confidently in front of groups, colleagues, and audiences.
impact.leadership: Serving as Club Treasurer and taking on meeting roles have helped me develop responsibility, coordination, and leadership skills while contributing to the club’s success.

advice: Don’t wait for confidence before you begin. Take the first step, keep showing up, and let confidence grow through experience.
story: For Nabeel, Toastmasters is not just about delivering speeches. It is about building confidence, expressing his thoughts freely, and growing as a person and a professional. He first joined in 2021, came back in 2026, and now serves as the club's Treasurer.
contribution: A steady hand on the club's finances as Treasurer, and a member who says yes to meeting roles, from Timer and Grammarian to Toastmaster of the Day.

name: Noufal Aboobacker
hook: Guest in 2020, member in 2025, now running meetings
challenge: Fear and a lack of confidence held Noufal back when speaking in front of people, and turning thoughts from Malayalam into English quickly made it harder still.
transformation: Today Noufal conducts meetings, coordinates role players, and serves as the club's Sergeant at Arms.

journey.text: First attended Talk-Masters as a guest in 2020.
Joined the club in August 2025, with a simple goal: to improve English and become more confident.
Took on Table Topics Master, Zoom Master of the Day and Sergeant at Arms, and served as Toastmaster of the Day for Meeting #106.
Now serving as the club's Sergeant at Arms for 2026–27.
Working through Level 2 speeches in the Dynamic Leadership path.

impact.career: As an IT professional, I have technical knowledge and experience, but I realised that technical skills alone are not enough to grow in a career. We also need to communicate our ideas clearly, share our opinions confidently, and explain technical problems to different people.
impact.confidence: Today, I may still feel nervous, and I may still make mistakes, but I no longer see them as reasons to stop speaking.
impact.leadership: By taking on roles such as Table Topics Master, Toastmaster of the Day, Zoom Master of the Day, and Sergeant at Arms, I am getting opportunities to take responsibility, coordinate with people, listen to different opinions, and help meetings run smoothly.

advice: Please don't make the same mistake I made by waiting for years before joining Talk-Masters. Don't wait for the perfect moment. Take the first step today. Come, join us, participate in the activities, take up roles, and experience the energy, positivity, and encouragement this club offers.
story: Noufal first came to Talk-Masters as a guest in 2020, but only joined in 2025. "Instead of focusing on the five years I missed, I am grateful that I finally took that first step." The energy, encouragement and support of fellow members are helping Noufal grow more confident at work and at home, and discover that the club is not just a place to improve speaking skills, but a place to find one's potential.
contribution: A steady presence who sets the room for every meeting as Sergeant at Arms, and says yes to roles, from Zoom Master to Toastmaster of the Day.
